title: Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels
mechanism: Two asymmetric learners, one prompt-driven and one refinement-driven, correct each other's noisy masks for small faint targets (abstract-level reading).
adaptation: Short faint crack components (76 to 88% under 20 px) are the closest analogue; would pair a prompt-based refiner with the house model to correct crack labels mutually. Details unread (MCP down).
min_experiment: Read the method first; if feasible, arm: mutual correction on crack labels; baseline: house; metric comp>=20px recall and relF1@2; kill if both n.d.
prior_overlap: partial: CPS/mutual learning was run at 5% for SSL, not for correcting labelled-set labels.
